REGULAR MEETING AGENDA
CITY COUNCIL OF THE CITY OF CERRITOS
AND THE SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY
THURSDAY - FEBRUARY 8, 2018 - CITY HALL -
07:00 P.M.
City Council Chamber
AGENDA MATERIALS: Reports and materials related to items on this Agenda are available for public inspection at the City Clerk's Office, Cerritos City Hall, 18125 Bloomfield Avenue, Cerritos, CA 90703, during normal business hours, 8 a.m. to 5 p.m., Monday through Friday, Telephone (562) 916-1248. Materials submitted to the City Council/Successor Agency after distribution of the agenda packet are available for public inspection in the City Clerk's Office at the above address during normal business hours as noted.
PUBLIC COMMENTS: For all Agenda Items, except for Consent Calendar Items, public comments will be allowed at the time each matter comes up for discussion. Please complete and submit a blue Speaker's Card to ensure that you are recognized when the Agenda item is considered. The general public comments portion of the meeting, under Agenda Item 6, will not exceed 45 minutes, and no speaker will be allowed more than five minutes, unless determined appropriate by the Chair. To assist in the preparation of appropriate responses, persons are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record.
PUBLIC HEARINGS: Public hearings will be conducted in the order indicated on the agenda, unless otherwise directed. Please complete and submit a blue Speakers Card if you wish to present testimony. Conduct of public hearings will occur in substantially the following sequence: the item to be heard is announced, a report of written correspondence and staff report are received, and the City Council asks questions of staff. The public hearing is opened and verbal testimony will occur in the following order: the applicant, if applicable, those in favor, opposed, or interested parties, and rebuttal by applicant. Speakers are requested, but not required, to state their name and city of residence for the record. After verbal testimony, the public hearing is closed and the matter is deliberated with a determination being made or a continuation of the matter.

This section is reserved for comments related to Consent Calendar Items and Items not listed on the Agenda but within the subject matter jurisdiction of the City Council/Successor Agency. Comments are limited to 5 minutes per person.
7.
Consent Calendar
Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by one motion. Subject to the discretion of the City Council/Successor Agency, there will be no separate discussion of these items unless a Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item may be removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.
7A.

City Council Communications/Committee Reports/Report on Meetings
During this part of the meeting members of the City Council report to the community on various matters of interest, including reports concerning committees on which the Councilmembers serve and reports on meetings/conferences attended. In addition, requests may be made of the staff for reports which will be presented to the City Council at a subsequent meeting, or for the scheduling of future agenda items. There will be no discussion or action taken on any of the items that may be presented during this agenda item.

MINUTES OF A REGULAR MEETING OF THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AND THE
SUCCESSOR AGENCY TO THE CERRITOS REDEVELOPMENT AGENCY HELD ON
FEBRUARY 8, 2018, IN THE COUNCIL CHAMBERS AT CERRITOS CITY HALL, 18125
BLOOMFIELD AVENUE, CERRITOS CALIFORNIA

1.  Call to Order

  The meeting was called to order at 7:00 p.m.

2.  Invocation

  The invocation was led by Councilmember Jim Edwards.

3.  Pledge of Allegiance

  The Pledge of Allegiance was led by City of Cerritos Recreation Services Division,
  Youth Basketball League Boys Pee Wee Team – Team Swish.

4.  Roll Call

  The following members of the City Council/Successor Agency were in attendance:

  Council/Agency Member Jim Edwards
  Council/Agency Member Naresh Solanki
  Council/Agency Member Frank A. Yokoyama
  Mayor Pro Tem/Vice Chair Mark E. Pulido
  Mayor/Chair Grace Hu

5.  Presentations

  Proclamation presented to:

  Cerritos Hornets Youth Football (2017 Southern California East Youth Football
  League Amateur Athletic Union 9-and-Under Super Bowl Champions).

  Chris Keseloff (2017 Next Generation Disc Golf Tour National Champion).

  Gahr High School Marching Gladiators (2017 California State Band
  Championships Grand Champions).

  Joan and Marty Flax (50th Wedding Anniversary).

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions

  Rene Jarantilla spoke in regards to parking on Elena Street.

  Katherine George Chu spoke in regards to the adaptive program offerings and
  requested a departmental review of the program.

  Yanet Lindner spoke regarding the City's overnight parking permit policy and
  suggested a review.

  Murali Vasudevan spoke regarding the last Planning Commission meeting and
  residents’ concerns.
 City of Cerritos  February 8, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 2 of 4

6.  Public Comments and Suggestions (continued)

  Anantha Ramachandran thanked the Council for recent home curb repainting
  and high density homes in Cerritos.

7.  Consent Calendar
  Items under the Consent Calendar are considered routine and will be enacted by
  one motion. There will be no separate discussion of these items unless a
  Council/Agency Member or citizen so requests, in which event the item will be
  removed from the Consent Calendar and considered separately.

7A.  Approval of Minutes

  Approval of the City Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of
  January 22, 2018 (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the City
  Council/Successor Agency Regular Meeting Minutes of January 22, 2018
  (COUNCIL/SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

7B.  Approval of Register of Demands

  Approval of the Register of Demands for the City of Cerritos dated February 8,
  2018 (COUNCIL).

  Approval of the Register of Demands for the Successor Agency to the Cerritos
  Redevelopment Agency dated February 8, 2018 (SUCCESSOR AGENCY).

  MOTION: It was moved by Hu, and seconded by Solanki, to approve the
  Register of Demands as follows:

  1. City of Cerritos  2/22/2018  $7,602,298.57  (COUNCIL)
  2. Successor Agency  2/22/2018  $2,550,000.00  (SUCCESSOR AGENCY)

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None
 City of Cerritos  February 8, 2018
City Council/Successor Agency  Page 3 of 4

8.  Public Hearings

8A.  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and adopt A RESOLUTION OF
  THE CERRITOS CITY COUNCIL AMENDING THE CERRITOS GENERAL PLAN LAND
  USE MAP BY CHANGING THE LAND USE DESIGNATION OF APPROXIMATELY
  ±1.98 ACRES OF LAND, LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET (APN 7030-002-
  902), FROM PUBLIC AND QUASI PUBLIC TO OFFICE PROFESSIONAL
  COMMERCIAL, HEREIN REFERENCED AS GENERAL PLAN AMENDMENT 2017-1
  (COUNCIL).*

  Review and consideration to waive full reading of and introduce AN ORDINANCE

  CHANGING THE ZONE CLASSIFICATION OF APPROXIMATELY ±1.98 ACRES OF
  LAND, LOCATED AT 12616 183RD STREET (APN 7030-002-902), FROM OPEN
  SPACE (OS) TO COMMERCIAL OFFICE PROFESSIONAL (COP), HEREIN
  REFERENCED AS DEVELOPMENT MAP AMENDMENT 2017-2 (COUNCIL).*

  *Pursuant to Section 15061(b)(3) of the California Environmental Quality Act
  (CEQA), this project is categorically exempt from CEQA Review.

  MOTION: It was moved by Yokoyama, and seconded by Pulido to continue this
  item to a future meeting.

  The motion carried (5 – 0) as follows:

  AYES:  Edwards, Solanki, Yokoyama, Pulido, Hu
  NOES:  None
  ABSENT:  None
  ABSTAIN:  None

9.  New and Old Business

9A.  Review and consideration of contracts for the design of Sports Complex Ballfield
  improvements, Project No. 10024 (COUNCIL).

  A staff report was given by Dario Simoes, Assistant City Engineer.

  The Mayor opened public comments.

  Noting there were no further individuals who elected to speak, the Mayor closed
  the public comments.

  MOTION: It was moved by Edwards, and seconded by Pulido, to:

  1. Award a contract for Cerritos Sports Complex field renovation design services
  to PRZ Consulting in an amount not to exceed $12,000; and

  2. Award a contract for Cerritos Sports Complex site survey work to Community
  Works Design Group in an amount not to exceed $37,740; and

  3. Authorize the City Manager or his designee to execute any contract
  modifications that may be necessary to complete the specified scope of work
  (COUNCIL).
